metadata.description: TEA-Core private skill registry — Lovable workflow skills plus shared meta-tooling, for Claude Code and Paperclip.

plugins.name: checkout-handoff
plugins.description: Enforces the mandatory /release-then-PATCH sequence every Paperclip agent must follow when handing off a checked-out issue, preventing stale executionRunId locks that cause up to 60-minute wakeOnDemand delays.

plugins.name: lovable-prompt-library
plugins.description: 200+ battle-tested Lovable prompts — router plus 16 lazy-loaded category files, includes the Default Lovable Prompt and the three universal rules (State Completeness, Minimal Diff, Rollback).

plugins.name: lovable-project-generator
plugins.description: 9-stage intake interview that generates a complete 11-page Notion project scaffold for a new Lovable build, with two checkpoints for ship-early options.

plugins.name: lovable-deployment-ops
plugins.description: Post-merge deployment verification for Lovable-managed Supabase projects — 4-layer verification framework (GitHub → Edge Functions → SQL → Frontend) with 9 battle-tested hallucination patterns.

plugins.name: lovable-notion-automation-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end Lovable+Notion workflow automation enforcing Plan → Approve → Implement → Verify → Loop with 8 non-negotiable rules, battle-tested across 70+ Plans.

plugins.name: lovable-verification-workflow
plugins.description: Automates Lovable implementation verification via Claude in Chrome browser tools, captures PASS/FAIL results, and records them to Notion.

plugins.name: lovable-secrets-extractor
plugins.description: Extracts edge function secrets from a Lovable-managed Supabase project by deploying a temporary Deno edge function and reconstructs a usable .env file.

plugins.name: lovable-tech-stack-workflow
plugins.description: Coordinator skill for safe work against Lovable's Supabase-backed stack — routes implement → verify → record → monitor with 9 hallucination-recovery patterns. Sister skill to lovable-deployment-ops.

plugins.name: tea-core-skill-registry
plugins.description: Discipline that keeps the TEA-Core skill corpus consistent across GitHub and the Obsidian vault — migration, conformance audit, and registration procedures for every skill.
